key_finding: L10/L11 reactive slots are SEMANTIC SALIENCE TRACKERS. At 86M scale, CDM learns to route the most topic-specific, semantically loaded tokens through the fastest-decaying slot. rose, chocolate, golden ratio, cosmic, universe all hit L10/slot6 with >0.5 routing probability. This is NOT syntax tracking — it is concept tracking. The volatile slot remembers the current topic concept briefly, then releases it. Deep slots hold the long-range structural context.
